about: Any route, asked by a shaderera older than the API takes, by its User-Agent (shaderera/<version>). The sentence names the version needed, and minimum is it. A User-Agent that is not shaderera/<version> is never refused this way.

body.error: This shaderera (0.1.0) is older than the films API takes: update to 0.1.5 or later (npx shaderera@latest).
